# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-01 from the 2026-11-01 Hub dump.

- 3,200,472 models tracked, 914,332 declare a base model, 947,528 parent links, 90,295 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
